finalLens.intro: After ending one maintenance loop, you reach toward the phone during a quiet hour before sleep.
finalLens.pull_quote: Your rest becomes available once loyalty stops assigning another small act of usefulness to the hour.

finalLens.watch_for: Watch for reopening the phone after finishing one task to search for another item that needs attention.
finalLens.move: After one completed loop, place the phone out of reach and keep the next hour task-free.

finalLens.title: Trim the Sequence.
finalLens.intro: Your attention catches the repeated step producing rework before the rest of the schedule has moved.
finalLens.pull_quote: A routine remains useful when its repeated steps reduce friction and leave room for the people using it.
finalLens.deeper_read: You take charge as soon as a flaw appears, so a schedule can become something to manage rather than something to examine. The more deliberately you work, the more revealing it is to leave one imperfect step untouched long enough to notice the person around it.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for yourself revising several parts of the schedule after identifying one troublesome repeated step.
finalLens.move: Change only the marked step for one cycle, then note whether the routine creates less rework.

finalLens.title: Choose the Next Owner.
finalLens.intro: Seeing the pattern in a meeting, you pause where the next handoff lacks an owner.
finalLens.pull_quote: Your sharpest contribution appears when a useful route becomes a responsibility someone can carry.
finalLens.deeper_read: You quickly detect the structure beneath a work problem and picture an alternative route. That agility serves the group when you bring it into execution by tying the next handoff to a visible owner.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for yourself moving to the next idea while the meeting leaves the handoff unassigned.
finalLens.move: Before the meeting ends, identify one person responsible for carrying the next handoff forward.

finalLens.watch_for: Watch for checking the phone again after ending one maintenance loop.
finalLens.move: Choose one sleep decision now, then leave the unfinished task untouched for the quiet hour.
